title: Referrals and Authorizations Billing-Lag Hold
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when the cancellation of an approved authorization counted in visits, hours or rental months is confirmed, a billing-lag hold covers visits made but not yet billed.

## Records read

The servicing provider's claim lines among the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines: the posted date of its most recent line, and how many of its lines are dated in the last month.

## Rule

| Servicing provider's most recent line | Its lines dated in the last month | Units held |
|---|---|---|
| posted no more than 3 days ago | 3 or more | 1 |
| posted no more than 3 days ago | fewer than 3 (the provider bills irregularly) | 2 |
| posted more than 3 days ago, or no line | any | 0 |

In words: where the servicing provider's most recent claim line was posted no more than three days ago and three or more of its lines are dated in the last month, one unit is held; where its most recent line was posted no more than three days ago and fewer than three of its lines are dated in the last month, two units are held; otherwise nothing is held.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; cancellation confirmed on 20 May)

- Most recent line posted 17 May (3 days before), 3 lines in the last month: 1 unit held.
- Most recent line posted 17 May, 2 lines in the last month: 2 units held.
- Most recent line posted 16 May (4 days before): nothing held.
